decision.reviewed_via: HUMAN_REVIEW.zh-CN.md (2026-08-21) with agent-assisted evidence summary; final decision made by project owner
decision.rationale: Mechanism-level claim (single-replica no-PDB deployment loses all capacity under pod-kill) is backed by static manifest facts, the r1 live Ready 1->0 window, the r2 disambiguation that downgraded the early HTTP 200 to an observation-window artifact, and the r4 two-replica counterfactual (3 deterministic UID co-proof samples; the 12 platform_blocked samples are observation-channel losses, not business evidence). Cross-project projection is authorized ONLY through feedback_protocol.knowledge_projection as a provisional prior for Online Boutique; it must not carry sock-shop runtime evidence and must be re-validated on Online Boutique single-replica services before any promotion.
constraints: projected abstraction must not contain FORBIDDEN_KB_FIELDS or FORBIDDEN_KB_MARKERS
knowledge_base_updated for the formal KB remains governed by the existing review gates

abstraction.applicability: single-replica deployment without a pod disruption budget under kill or cpu fault families
abstraction.expected_effect: full outage window until a replacement pod becomes Ready and enters Service endpoints
abstraction.early_success_samples_are_not_defense: an HTTP success during the kill window can be an observation-window artifact when no ready endpoint exists
abstraction.verification_recipe: scale the deployment to two replicas, repeat the same kill, and require a surviving Ready pod UID in Service endpoints serving the business oracle
